chars.DAD: DAD: an older man wearing a cream djellaba with thin brown stripes, a red fez hat, brown leather slippers.
chars.SON: SON: a young man wearing a brand-new navy blue suit, light blue shirt, no tie, shiny black shoes.
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young woman wearing an emerald green kaftan with a gold embroidered belt and a beige headscarf.
chars.MOM: MOM: a middle-aged woman wearing a burgundy djellaba and a pink headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a cozy Moroccan salon in Casablanca with long blue sedari sofas and patterned cushions, DAD stands frozen staring intensely with narrowed suspicious eyes at a framed photo hanging on the wall (the photo shows only a blurry woman in green), while SON sits on the sofa behind him holding a bouquet of red roses and a box of chocolates, smiling happily.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: On the blue Moroccan sofa, SON leans toward DAD and whispers with a worried face; DAD rubs his chin, eyes looking sideways, thinking hard as if trying to remember something.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan salon, SON laughs relaxed and waves his hand as if saying never mind, MOM next to him smiles proudly; a low round table with sweets and almonds in front of them.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: GIRL walks shyly through the doorway of the Moroccan salon carrying a silver tray with a teapot and small decorated tea glasses, smiling politely, looking down.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside the Moroccan salon, GIRL suddenly sees DAD sitting on the sofa and drops the silver tray; the teapot and tea glasses fly in the air and splash on the carpet; her mouth open in shock; DAD on the sofa wide-eyed.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Close view of GIRL standing still in the Moroccan salon doorway, her face pale with shock, hands trembling near her mouth, spilled tea glasses on the floor near her feet.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: DAD sits stiff and frozen on the blue Moroccan sofa, sweating, eyes wide, not moving; SON beside him turns his head toward DAD totally confused, still holding the roses.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: GIRL hurries out of the Moroccan salon through a hallway with zellige tiles, covering her face with both hands, crying, her green kaftan flowing behind her.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Wide view of the Moroccan salon: an awkward heavy silence, DAD stares down at the floor avoiding eyes, SON looks at DAD with a suspicious questioning face, MOM looks from one to the other puzzled; broken tea glasses on the carpet.
